creator: kevinfremon
title: Trillion adds a 'Subagent Routine Manager': per-agent settings panel with a routine editor to schedule when each subagent fires and what it does; waitlist passed 1,000 (goal 5,000)

tools.name: Trillion
tools.detail: voice-first local AI agent; GitHub repo waitlist at hellotrillion.ai

tools.name: Subagent Routine Manager
tools.detail: settings modal: pick agent on left, configure routines (time of day/week, task) on right

claims: GitHub repo waitlist hit 1,000+ signups; goal 5,000 before diverting energy to release it free
Each subagent gets its own editing panel; routine editor schedules exactly when each agent fires and what it does
Voice-first design had hidden what routines were doing; the panel restores transparency and editability
Routines should be tuned over time as agents' outputs are reviewed; prompt to be shared once hardened
how_to_steps: Open settings icon in the agent UI
Select a subagent from the left list
Scroll to existing routines; set time of week/day, edit the instruction, or add a new routine
on_screen_only: hellotrillion.ai page 'The road to the repo' - LIVE COUNT 1,009 signed up so far, 3,991 to go until focused work on a deploy-ready build
Settings modal with list of subagents (avatars) on the left and routine fields on the right: schedule, instructions text area, 'Weekly digest' style routine, save button
Glowing orb agent visualization on the laptop
cta: Share videos, sign up for the repo waitlist

relevance.why: The need (visible, editable schedules for agent routines) is real for Haji's Routines/cron-driven Claude sessions, but the video is a product-progress update with no shareable prompt or code.

implement_score.why: Equivalent already exists for Haji via Claude Code Routines (create_trigger/list_triggers); the lesson is to keep a reviewable list of routine prompts and tune them. Nothing to install.

gap.what: duplicate of liked content: liked set already covers Trillion and scheduled-task/routine tooling (Cowork cloud scheduled tasks, Paperclip heartbeat scheduling)
